hint_ladder.title: Fraction to Percent
hint_ladder.text: To convert a fraction to a percentage, multiply the fraction by 100%.

hint_ladder.title: Set Up the Multiplication
hint_ladder.text: Compute (3/5) × 100%. This is the same as (3 × 100%) / 5.

hint_ladder.title: Final Answer
hint_ladder.text: So 3/5 = 60%. The correct choice is C.

A.text: You might have chosen A because you multiplied 3/5 by 10% instead of 100%, landing on 30%.

B.text: You might have chosen B because you misremembered 1/5 as 15% and mistakenly added to reach 35%, instead of 20% per 1/5.

D.text: You might have chosen D because you added 5% to the correct 60%, or confused 3/5 with 13/20.

next_time_rule: To convert fraction to percent, multiply by 100%. For 3/5: (3×100)/5 = 60%. Remember: divide numerator by denominator, then × 100%.
deconstruct_text:
Sa barangay budget meeting, sinabi ni Kap na 3/5 ng pondo ay para sa health. Gusto mong malaman kung ilang porsyento yan. Madali lang 'yan, Ate/Kuya magtuturo.

Rule: fraction × 100% = percent. Kaya 3/5 × 100% = (3×100)/5 = 300/5 = 60%. Pwede ring decimal: 3 ÷ 5 = 0.6, then 0.6 × 100% = 60%.

Kung nakita mo ang 30%, malamang nag-multiply ka ng 10% sa halip na 100%. Common mistake yan. Kaya tandaan: multiply by 100% lagi.
